overview: Incremental pre-release update to the adventure module. Key changes: objectives subsystem gets new treasure chest interactions (open container, destroy condition), inventory-change-aware task system replaces event-based inventory tracking, TreasureChestState renamed to TreasureChestBlock (component migration), and GatherObjectiveTask now uses InventoryChangeAware interface. Minor changes across farming, memories, and other sub-modules.

objectives.summary: Major refactoring of treasure chest system and inventory tracking. TreasureChestState renamed to TreasureChestBlock (ChunkStore component). New ObjectiveInventoryChangeSystem replaces LivingEntityInventoryChangeEvent listener for tracking item drops and gather tasks. New interaction types for treasure containers.

types_added.purpose: Renamed from TreasureChestState. Block component tracking treasure chest state: objectiveUUID, chestUUID, opened flag. Now adds canDestroy() method gating destruction on opened state.

Server-side condition interaction that checks if a treasure block can be destroyed. Returns Finished if canDestroy() is true (chest is opened), Failed otherwise. Prevents players from breaking unopened treasure chests.

Opens the item container of a treasure chest block. Combines TreasureChestBlock canOpen() check with ContainerBlockWindow creation, plays open/close sounds, manages block interaction states ('OpenWindow'/'CloseWindow'), and calls treasureBlock.onOpen() to fire TreasureChestOpeningEvent.

New system that listens for InventoryChangeEvent on Player entities. Replaces the previous LivingEntityInventoryChangeEvent event listener approach. Handles two responsibilities: (1) removes players from objectives when they drop objective items (removeOnItemDrop flag), and (2) notifies InventoryChangeAware tasks of inventory changes for count-based tracking.

Interface for objective tasks that need to react to player inventory changes. Defines onInventoryChange(Objective, Ref<EntityStore>, Store<EntityStore>, InventoryChangeEvent). Implemented by GatherObjectiveTask.

types_removed.reason: Renamed to TreasureChestBlock. Was previously registered as a BlockState; now registered as a Component<ChunkStore>. Functionally identical fields (objectiveUUID, chestUUID, opened) plus new canDestroy() method.
